internal/acphost.unhandledUpdates keys the ignored-update warning by update type so the process logs each type once.
internal/artifact/gitrepo.openMu serialises git init in Open, which takes a directory path and no Repo value to hold a lock.
internal/artifact/gitrepo.snapshotInUse is keyed by index file path, and prune sweeps a cache directory that Repo values of one project share.
internal/artifact/gitrepo.snapshotPruned is keyed by cache directory path, which Repo values of one project share.
internal/contentreplica.retentionOwners is a registry filled by MustRegisterRetentionOwner from package init and frozen at first read.
internal/ledger.readIndexesMu guards a registry filled by MustRegisterReadIndex from package init and closed once a database opens.
internal/logs.Install sets slog's process-wide default handler once.
internal/memory.fallback stands in for flock on Windows, keyed by file path, so locks on one path exclude each other across every store in the process.
internal/node.lastGeneration makes nextGeneration strictly increasing across Servers started in one process.
internal/node.probeMu lets one MCP probe run at a time per machine, since a probe starts a server that competes for the machine's credentials and ports.
internal/nodewire.namesMu guards the display-name source read by nodewire.Name, a free function called from admin, turn, exec, delegate and project.
internal/nodewire.selfMu guards the name read by nodewire.Place, a free function called from turn, exec, delegate, roster and app.
internal/readmodel.platform holds the tool catalogue that SetPlatformTools installs from the constants agentmcp.ServerName and agentmcp.ToolTitles.
